notes: First-pass test-reserve annotation batch test-reserve-initial-20261028-v1. No model output was consulted. objects.description: the blue cylinder, rendered purple in the ego stream

frames.note: start (initial candidate): The purple cylinder rests on the lit seabed to the right of the open gripper; a red cylinder to the left is a distractor. This frame precedes the first close at159.

approach (initial candidate): The rendered fingers are still spread beside the purple cylinder and do not visibly carry it, despite the proprioceptive signal already being high after the failed first close. Use the image rather than the close signal as the ownership evidence.

grasp (initial candidate): After the reopen at186 and second close at190, the cylinder crosses the closed fingertips and remains at the gripper. Whether its lower surface is still supported by the floor at this frame is not established by the +0.029m robot-height change alone.
